basic_details.job_title: National Book Trust Young Professional Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: National Book Trust Recruitment 2026: National Book Trust has released the official notification for 1 Young Professional (For Exhibition) posts, inviting applications from eligible candidates. This recruitment provides an excellent opportunity for candidates seeking stable and well-paid government jobs.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 32 years. Age relaxation will be as per government rules.

qualification.education_qualification: Graduation in Mass Communication/Management/Humanities or related discipline from recognized University, Postgraduate degree or diploma in Mass Communications/Public Relations/Marketing (preferable), Minimum 5 years experience in planning, coordination and execution of events, exhibitions, conferences in Government/cultural/reputed organization
qualification.details: Graduation in Mass Communication/Management/Humanities or related discipline from a recognized University. Postgraduate degree or diploma in Mass Communications/Public Relations/Marketing is preferable. Minimum 5 years of experience in planning, coordination, and execution of events, exhibitions, and conferences in a Government/cultural/reputed organization.

salary_details.details: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 70,000.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for National Book Trust Young Professional (For Exhibition) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.nbtindia.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 01-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the National Book Trust Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the National Book Trust Young Professional (For Exhibition) post is 01 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Graduation in Mass Communication/Management/Humanities or a related discipline. A Postgraduate degree or diploma in Mass Communications/Public Relations/Marketing is preferred, along with 5 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional (For Exhibition) post is 32 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary in the range of Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 70,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Young Professional (For Exhibition) post in the National Book Trust.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the National Book Trust recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Young Professional role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Young Professional (For Exhibition) post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Young Professional (For Exhibition) post is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the National Book Trust, which is www.nbtindia.gov.in.
